playbooks.title: Disease → deterministic shortlist
playbooks.goal: Produce an of-record ranked shortlist for a disease/indication with free-API provenance.

steps.title: Resolve disease & pin targets
steps.human: On Discover, enter disease; confirm multi-hit; pin 1–3 targets if known.

steps.title: Rank (deterministic)
steps.human: Run Rank; read score math tooltips and Why ranked chips — not AI.
steps.agent: Inspect candidates table; timingMs.total for M7; never re-rank with LLM.

steps.title: Densify top-K
steps.human: Enable safety/novelty densify; promote candidates that survive soft-flags.

steps.title: Save to project
steps.human: Save ≥1 candidate to a local project for pack loop.
steps.agent: UI project store (browser); verify product events in logs.

successSignals: densify/harvest provenance on top-K when enabled
lawReminders: No LLM in Discover rank path
Empty harvest ≠ no safety signal forever — retry with patience

playbooks.title: CID evidence deep-dive
playbooks.goal: Build an of-record evidence picture for one molecule before synthesis or wet-lab planning.

steps.title: Open profile / fetch categories
steps.human: Molecule profile; wait Core categories; use Monitor for gaps.

steps.title: Close gaps
steps.human: Retry failed categories; load idle Core; open sparse panels.
steps.agent: Ask copilot fix_gap / load_category; or category with refresh=1

steps.title: Ledger + kit
steps.human: Data hub Fact|Value|Source|Open; download Research kit.

steps.title: Optional AI (non-of-record)
steps.human: Copilot Ask with citations; refuse if thin completeness.
steps.agent: Agent loop tools then answer; never invent trials/AEs.

successSignals: Core categories loaded or explicitly empty/timeout
Research kit factCount > 0 with content hashes
AI answers cite [panel] keys or refuse with gaps
lawReminders: AI investigation priority only — no regulatory decision language
User verifies before wet-lab / grant claims

playbooks.title: Board pack → research hypothesis
playbooks.goal: Promote shortlist candidates into a claim-bound pack and draft RH for investigation.

steps.title: Promote & harvest
steps.human: Board → Promote candidates; wait safety harvest.
steps.agent: boardHarvest via app; logs grep product.

steps.title: Build pack
steps.human: Build pack → download; note claim/citable counts and warnings.
steps.agent: pack extract; assert subjectCandidateId; max 5 extractors.

steps.title: Pack AI (optional)
steps.human: Run gap analysis / executive brief / next experiment on pack.

steps.title: Seed RH
steps.human: Open Research Hypothesis; edit claim-bound statements.
steps.agent: seed_research_hypothesis; do not auto-apply board decisions.

successSignals: citable claims meet happy-path density or explicit warning
RH statements rehydrate to real claim text
Pack AI refuses free invention under min claims

playbooks.title: Compare candidates & choose
playbooks.goal: Decide investigation priority among 2–N candidates with of-record facts.

steps.title: Session set
steps.human: Open 2+ molecule profiles so session history holds them.

steps.title: Side-by-side hub
steps.human: Compare hub / dual strip; export if sharing offline.
steps.agent: research kit per CID; kit-diff on /methodology

steps.title: Decision capture
steps.human: Promote winner; watch/archive others; optional RH note.
steps.agent: Project store status only — no silent auto-promote from AI.

successSignals: No of-record score rewritten by AI reorder views
lawReminders: Optional AI analysis views must be labeled non-of-record

playbooks.title: Agent ops: health → research → gate
playbooks.goal: Run a safe automation loop without violating product law.

steps.title: Gate before merge
steps.agent: biointel gate; e2e auto if north-star touched

lawReminders: Do not add paid APIs or LLM ranking
Do not write exploits or attack scripts
Prefer main; no dual-emit product event aliases
